runtime.provider: hcloud CLI as external upstream dependency (argv, shell=False, bounded timeout, location not datacenter)
runtime.license: MIT for legends-hetzner sources; hcloud CLI remains upstream external dependency, not vendored

provision_support: live-canary-validated: Windows client, Ubuntu 24.04 server; see docs/VALIDATION.md
provision_note: Disposable live canary validated with the released 0.1.0 wheel: Windows/Python 3.11.7, hcloud 1.70.1, CX23/FSN1/Ubuntu 24.04; create/readback, key-based SSH, cloud-init and cleanup passed. Version 0.1.2 changes evidence labels, not provider execution. Other live client/image/location combinations and application health remain unvalidated.
scope_limits: Single CLI invocation per create; upstream hcloud HTTP retries (if any) are outside this wrapper and unaudited.
Custom endpoints unsupported: HCLOUD_ENDPOINT/HCLOUD_HOST/HCLOUD_DEBUG are stripped; upstream public defaults only.
No datacenter support: location only (datacenters removed Oct1; deprecated in hcloud 1.61.0).
DNS/load balancers/firewalls/volumes/networks out of scope for v0.1.2.
Live canary is bounded to the documented configuration; macOS/Linux live writes and application/restore health are not validated.

auth.rule: Explicit HCLOUD_TOKEN xor hcloud named context. Both set is AUTH_AMBIGUOUS. Neither is AUTH_MISSING for live commands.
auth.consistency: Single auth selection per invocation; --context passed to every hcloud call when selected; HCLOUD_TOKEN removed from child env when context selected.
auth.planned_binding: server plan records global --context as planned_context (or null for token mode); preflight/create fail with PLAN_CONTEXT_MISMATCH when active selection differs.
auth.env_safety: Child env strips HCLOUD_ENDPOINT, HCLOUD_HOST, HCLOUD_DEBUG. Token never in argv, never printed, never persisted. Only known token value and credential-labeled values redacted; SHA256 plan/user-data digests stay printable.

globals.help: Use hcloud named context for every call; bound into plans at plan time and enforced at preflight/create.
Bounded per-call subprocess timeout (also guards readback; timeouts report uncertain_*).

doctor.default: offline (no auth; reads hcloud version only). Exit nonzero when hcloud missing, errored, or Python <3.11 (readiness gate).
doctor.live: requires explicit auth; read-only probe via location list. Exit 5 on AUTH_MISSING, 1 when live_ok false, 0 only when live_ok true.

inventory.output: JSON {servers:[...], count:n} to stdout; malformed provider JSON is HCLOUD_BAD_JSON, never false empty

catalog.output: JSON to stdout; malformed provider JSON is HCLOUD_BAD_JSON, never false empty

server plan.usage: server plan --name NAME --type TYPE --location LOC --image IMG --ssh-key KEY [--ssh-key KEY...] [--user-data FILE] [--label k=v ...] --out FILE
server plan.auth: offline (no auth needed); global --context if given is recorded as planned_context
rules: SSH key required (at least one; names or numeric IDs)
location accepts name or numeric ID
user-data optional, <=32768 bytes, must start with #cloud-config or #!/
emits immutable plan file {plan:{...planned_context...}, plan_hash:sha256:...} with timezone-aware created_at
server plan.output: JSON {ok:true, plan_hash, out, planned_context} to stdout

server preflight.auth: live read-only, requires explicit auth; enforces planned_context then checks name/type/location/image/keys plus support/arch/deprecation/availability
server preflight.schema: Observed hcloud server_type.locations[] entries carry id,name,deprecation, with available/recommended added in newer versions. The adapter also tolerates a string location selector field. Image deprecation replaces the legacy deprecated boolean; datacenter endpoints were removed October 1, 2026.
server preflight.strictness: All five list probes must return JSON arrays or the run fails HCLOUD_BAD_JSON (no false pass). Missing type locations[] or missing type/image architecture blocks. Duplicate image names resolve by type architecture; exact numeric image IDs pin and may fail incompatible.
server preflight.capacity: available=true is capacity indication, not guarantee; available=false means no capacity and blocks; missing available (hcloud 1.61) is labeled unknown, not true.
server preflight.output: JSON {passed, checks:[...], failures:[...]}; exit 3 when passed=false

server create.usage: server create --plan FILE --plan-hash sha256:... --approve [--dry-run] [--receipt FILE] [--max-plan-age-hours H]
server create.auth: live, requires explicit auth; enforces planned_context
rules: Requires --approve plus nonempty formatted --plan-hash (sha256:<64 hex>) matching embedded plan_hash. Empty/malformed/None never bypasses (None legal only for offline preflight load).
Verifies plan_hash, planned_context, user-data digest, SSH keys, timezone-aware created_at, finite positive max age (default 24h). Tampered/stale/mismatched plans abort with no write.
Validates --receipt writable before any cloud write; refuses to overwrite.
Live preflight (existence plus location support, availability, deprecation, arch compat) must pass or abort with no write.
--dry-run runs preflight only and makes no writes.
One CLI invocation only; no client-side retry of server create (upstream HTTP retries unaudited).
user-data sent from a private 0600 temp snapshot of reviewed bytes with digest re-verified (no TOCTOU).

Readback contract: success confirmation requires describe id AND name match plus plan type/location/image comparison (direct and nested shapes validated; invalid shapes stay unknown). Timeouts report uncertain_* via readback, never failed; CLI failure with existing resource reports uncertain_exists; inconclusive readback reports uncertain_unknown; never false success or false no-resource.
Receipt (if --receipt) is redacted JSON with plan_hash and digest only, no token, no user-data content; digests stay printable.
server create.output: Receipt JSON to stdout; optional receipt file (refuses to overwrite).

resources.resolves: Installed legends_hetzner/_data/ adjacent to the package first (ordinary pip wheels), else checkout root proven by module-specific markers (docs/CLI-CONTRACT.json, AGENTS marker, matching pyproject, or recipe+pack pair); bare docs//knowledge/ never counts.
resources.output: JSON {version, root, recipe, recipe_exists, pack_dir, pack_exists, pack_files[], cloud_init_dir, skills_cto_legends, source} with absolute paths

exit_codes.0: success (including dry-run with passing preflight; doctor only when checks pass / live_ok true)
exit_codes.1: general provider/adapter failure, sanitized (HCLOUD_EXIT, HCLOUD_BAD_JSON, TIMEOUT, HCLOUD_NOT_FOUND, HCLOUD_OS_ERROR, HCLOUD_DECODE_ERROR); also offline doctor with missing/errored hcloud
exit_codes.2: usage/validation/plan/auth-ambiguous (including PLAN_TAMPERED, PLAN_STALE, PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH, PLAN_CONTEXT_MISMATCH, NEED_APPROVAL, AUTH_AMBIGUOUS, RECEIPT_PATH_INVALID)
exit_codes.4: create failed or uncertain (see receipt status failed|uncertain_*)
exit_codes.5: auth missing for live command (including doctor --live)

plan_file.shape: {plan:{version:1, tool, name, server_type, location, image, ssh_keys[], planned_context|null, user_data|null, user_data_sha256|null, labels{}, created_at, tool_version}, plan_hash:sha256:...}
plan_file.hash: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators) of plan payload, prefixed sha256:
plan_file.created_at: must be timezone-aware ISO-8601; naive values rejected (no TypeError crash)
plan_file.max_age: must be finite and positive; NaN/inf/zero/negative/non-numeric rejected
plan_file.user_data_digest: sha256:<hex> of UTF-8 user-data bytes; verified on load and re-verified on private snapshot at create

receipt.shape: {tool, version, created_at, plan_hash, plan_name, status, dry_run, preflight, server, error, readback, auth_source, provision_support}
receipt.redaction: Known HCLOUD_TOKEN value, Authorization/Bearer credentials, JSON/quoted token|secret|api-key assignments, and sensitive-keyed dict values redacted; plan_hash and user-data digests stay printable; no user-data content; errors truncated to 2000 chars.

packaging_data.note: Lead owns setuptools wiring. Runtime resolves adjacent _data first, then marker-proven checkout root.
